metadata.prompt: Static frontal camera view: A 121g black ball is suspended high above a wooden plank, which is fixed on a black perforated optical table. Coefficient of friction is 0.81; coefficient of restitution is 0.58. When released, the ball undergoes free fall, bounces only twice with rapidly diminishing heights, and comes to rest on the plank within about one and a half seconds, staying still for the rest of the video. Maintain structural integrity and object consistency throughout: no changing shapes, no blending, and no flashing background.
